item.name: The Strongest Hero
item.playstyle: Balanced all-rounder with fast M1s, simple-to-advanced combos, and low range or mobility.
item.baseMoves: Normal Punch, Consecutive Punches, Shove, Uppercut
item.ultimateMoves: Death Counter, Table Flip, Serious Punch, Omni-Directional Punch
item.cardSummary: Beginner-friendly free fighter with a mix of fast and heavy hits. Serious Mode lasts until you spend a move or die, trading healing for one-shot ultimate tools.

item.name: Hero Hunter
item.playstyle: Close-range grab and burst fighter with a strong counter, but no dedicated mobility tools.
item.baseMoves: Flowing Water, Lethal Whirlwind Stream, Hunter's Grasp, Prey's Peril
item.ultimateMoves: Water Stream Cutting Fist, The Final Hunt, Rock Splitting Fist, Crushed Rock
item.cardSummary: Free martial-arts kit built around grabs, burst damage, and Prey's Peril counters. Best for players comfortable staying in close range during Rampage.

item.name: Hero Hunter (Monster Form)
item.playstyle: Aggressive alternate Garou kit with better range options and high-skill mix-ups.
item.baseMoves: Doom Dive, Crowd Buster, Hammer Heel, Binding Cloth
item.ultimateMoves: Hunter's Mark, Great Fajin, God Slayer, Sky Ripping Fist
item.unlockNote: Free alternate moveset. Open the star next to Hero Hunter and choose Monster Form. No mastery requirement.
item.cardSummary: Free Hero Hunter alternate kit focused on monster-form pressure and Limit Breaker. Also opens a Cosmic Form path after the marked God Slayer route.

item.name: Destructive Cyborg
item.playstyle: Mid-to-long range zoning fighter with chip damage and strong gap closers.
item.baseMoves: Machine Gun Blows, Ignition Burst, Blitz Shot, Jet Dive
item.ultimateMoves: Thunder Kick, Speedblitz Dropkick, Flamewave Cannon, Incinerate
item.cardSummary: Free cyborg moveset for players who want mid-range pressure and chip tools. Maximum Energy Output rewards clean spacing more than reckless close-range trades.

item.name: Deadly Ninja
item.playstyle: High-mobility hit-and-run fighter with strong whiff punish tools.
item.baseMoves: Flash Strike, Whirlwind Kick, Scatter, Explosive Shuriken
item.ultimateMoves: Twinblade Rush, Straight On, Carnage, Fourfold Flashstrike
item.cardSummary: Free ninja kit for players who like speed, repositioning, and short engagements. The ultimate keeps reusable tools instead of one-and-done finishers.

item.name: Brutal Demon
item.playstyle: Aggressive bat fighter with strong block-breakers and slower M1 speed.
item.baseMoves: Homerun, Beatdown, Grand Slam, Foul Ball
item.ultimateMoves: Savage Tornado, Brutal Beatdown, Strength Difference, Death Blow
item.cardSummary: Free power-focused kit built around bat swings that open blocks and start combos. Pumped Up adds heavy splash tools and a rare instant-kill counter option.

item.name: Blade Master
item.playstyle: Technical swordsman with mobility tools, combo extenders, and a base counter.
item.baseMoves: Quick Slice, Atmos Cleave, Pinpoint Cut, Split Second Counter
item.ultimateMoves: Sunset, Solar Cleave, Sunrise, Atomic Slash
item.cardSummary: Free sword kit that rewards tech and timing more than raw button mashing. Split Second Counter turns defense into a combo start when you read the opponent.

item.name: Wild Psychic
item.playstyle: Grab and multi-target controller with strong keepout and combo extension tools.
item.baseMoves: Crushing Pull, Windstorm Fury, Stone Coffin, Expulsive Push
item.ultimateMoves: Cosmic Strike, Psychic Ricochet, Terrible Tornado, Sky Snatcher
item.cardSummary: Free esper kit for crowd control and keepout. Lower individual hit damage is traded for grabs, multi-target tools, and Berserk pressure.

item.name: Martial Artist
item.playstyle: Flexible close fighter with strong mobility mix-ups and safer neutral tools.
item.baseMoves: Bullet Barrage, Vanishing Kick, Whirlwind Drop, Head First
item.ultimateMoves: Grand Fissure, Twin Fangs, Earth Splitting Strike, Last Breath
item.cardSummary: Free martial kit built for unpredictable approaches and escapes. Vanishing Kick and Whirlwind Drop give more neutral flexibility than raw damage.

item.name: Tech Prodigy
item.playstyle: Zoning and AoE pressure kit that forces opponents to respect long windups.
item.baseMoves: Weboom, Plasma Cannon, Trinity Tear, Twin Burst
item.ultimateMoves: Photon Edge, Photon Dive, Conquest, Missiles
item.unlockNote: Free for all players. Formerly Early Access before the kit finished.
item.cardSummary: Free gadget fighter for zoning and team-fight AoE. Slow startups make it punishable, but the kit can lock down space once the pressure sticks.

item.name: Undying Hero
item.playstyle: Weapon-swapping hybrid with axe and pistol tools, strong multi-target hits, and limited mobility.
item.baseMoves: Grave Maker, Blast Breaker, Point Blank, Crossfire
item.unlockNote: Requires the Early Access gamepass while unfinished. Becomes free after the character is finished.
item.cardSummary: Current Early Access fighter based on Zombieman. Base kit is complete with four weapon-driven moves, while the Unkillable ultimate move list is still unfinished in public sources.

item.name: Sorcerer
item.playstyle: Private-server power fantasy with Infinity defense and multi-one-shot tools.
item.unlockNote: Private Server+ exclusive. Usable by the private server owner with the Private Server+ gamepass. Not a normal public-server competitive pick.
item.cardSummary: Exclusive Gojo-inspired kit locked behind Private Server+. Infinity toggles defense and empowered tools, and the kit has no standard Awakening mode.

item.name: KJ
item.playstyle: Overpowered limited joke kit with high damage and special private-server access rules.
item.baseMoves: Ravage, Swift Sweep, Collateral Ruin, Spiraling Storm
item.ultimateMoves: Stoic Bomb, 20-20-20 Dropkick, Five Seasons, Unlimited Flex Works
item.unlockNote: Limited exclusive access. Typically private-server only, with occasional temporary unlocks or donation-leaderboard access. Not a normal free public pick.
item.cardSummary: Limited parody moveset with intentionally broken damage tools and the 20 Series ultimate. Treat it as a special-access character, not part of the free public roster.

item.name: The Frozen Soul
item.playstyle: Juggernaut ice boss kit with heavy AoE pressure and high durability.
item.baseMoves: Permafrost, Frost Forge, Freezing Path, Judgement Chain
item.unlockNote: No longer a standard public character pick. Can still be spawned or used through the Fractal of Tundra path with Private Server+.
item.cardSummary: Limited winter-boss moveset kept as a special-access kit rather than a free public fighter. Sources document the full base ice kit and at least one ultimate tool.
